name: Reflective Card

metalness.description: Raises the contrast between the dark and bright gradient stops.

roughness.description: Widens the specular band and softens the brushed streaks.

lightAngle.description: Resting direction of the specular band, in degrees.

shift.description: Band travel on hover, as a percent of the surface.

a11y: The metal gradients and specular band are painted with background-image and a decorative ::after; nothing is added to the accessibility tree.
The CSS forces text colour through --genui-reflective-card-ink (default #111), so an author can flip it to #fff on a dark tone and keep contrast.
outline-offset: 3px keeps the focus ring clear of the card's own reflective surface.
Keyboard focus (:focus-visible / :focus-within) plays the same band shift as hover, so the state is not mouse-only.
